judged_text: The webhook handler (app-credential.ts:57-59) lets appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body) and JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...)) throw uncaught on malformed/undecryptable input, producing generic 500s — a caller can't distinguish a permanent 4xx (don't retry) from a transient 5xx (retry), so a bad payload can be retried forever; should use safeParse with explicit 400s.

adjudication.rationale: In the newly added webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the code calls `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` and then `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` without any try/catch or `safeParse` handling. Both `parse` and `JSON.parse` (and `symmetricDecrypt` if given bad ciphertext/key) can throw on malformed input, which in a Next.js API route will result in an unhandled exception and a generic 500 response. This makes malformed/undecryptable payloads look like server errors instead of explicit 4xx client errors.
